name: bro
description: Claude Code, at home in bro: your sessions and limits one keystroke away, and a chime and a clock on Claude's questions.

chime.title: Question chime
chime.description: A chime when Claude asks you a question.

timer.title: Question timer
timer.description: Seconds a question waits for you before Claude goes with its best judgement, with a countdown above it; 0 for no timer.

ticks.title: Countdown ticks
ticks.description: The question timer ticks for its last 15 seconds.
